topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: The air thickens, a shift in the silence. My paws skid on the unfamiliar floor, each step an echo in the space that wasn’t here before. Shadows loom, corners sharp and accusing. I circle, nose twitching, scenting the cold trail of what was once sealed away. This place, it smells of wrong, of secrets long buried, now spilled open. My heart pounds, each beat a drum urging flight, but I am trapped, the walls closing in. I can’t find the way back, the path twisted, the exit a ghost. Shadows stretch, reaching, and I feel the edges of something far worse than this hidden room. I must find a way out, but the fear in the air thickens, choking, and I am alone, so alone, in this place that was never meant to be found.
